name: Marie
source:
Marie is a character added in Persona 4 Golden. Marie is cranky, sarcastic, irritable, very foul-mouthed and often prone to mood swings. She will not hesitate to voice out her opinion or express her thoughts, regardless of how it would make everyone feel. However, her "lack of emotion" is basically just her way to deal with her own shyness, insecurity and naïveté. This is also why she wants the [url=/c46285]Protagonist[/url] to show her Inaba: She wants to learn about the world and who she really is.

Marie sometimes expresses her thoughts in poems which often deal with depressing themes like farewells and existentialism, questioning her own origin. However, her poems almost always tend to suck and she gets embarrassed when she finds the protagonist reading them. Besides this, Marie is into fashion, loves nature (another major theme in her poems) and is apparently concerned about her figure, which is why she only eats healthy food.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Marie]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

She wields the [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Kaguya_Hime]Kaguya[/url] persona, a character from the famous folk story called "The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter".
